scope: Pre-publication validation of the current public working tree cleanup; no published-history rewrite.
raw_records: Preserved privately outside papers; names, digests and normalized public views are described in publication-path-normalization.json.
public_path_policy: No host-local paths in Git-visible content. Current-working-tree and exact-index modes inspect text, PDFs, archives and symlinks. Ignored local outputs are not published.
historical_git_scope: By the author's decision, existing Git history is retained. This cleanup applies to the current publishable tree and future commits.
